testing.partial_validation: npm run test:fast (explicitly skips private SQL; cannot certify a release)
testing.runtime: Node from .nvmrc; full validation requires hash-verified canonical SQL and exact historical upgrade artifacts.
principles: Before adding a test, identify the observable behavior, relevant input/state classes and a realistic regression it must detect. Reuse existing coverage where possible.
Prefer integration tests with real PostgreSQL/RLS and real transport contracts. Use pure unit tests for deterministic algorithms and UI tests for interactions.
Keep doubles at external boundaries or to provoke difficult failures. Do not mock the behavior being tested or reproduce the implementation in the expected result.
Use independent expected values for points, partitions and preservation of historical data. Test source strings only for explicit architecture or privacy constraints.
For important bugs, demonstrate failure without the fix and success with it. For critical test additions, run a targeted valid mutation and require an assertion failure.
Review tests independently for surviving regressions, vacuous assertions, own-module mocks and reductions in include, thresholds, assertions or executed suites.
Report executed and omitted suites, selected coverage denominator, runtime and meaningful limitations. Fewer tests can improve quality when duplicates or implementation checks are removed.
E2E must verify DEV SQL against this commit's artifact before fixture writes, use accredited disposable identities and preserve the shared lease throughout execution and cleanup.
Never run dev/typegen/build simultaneously against .next, publish private SQL or credentials to Git, or modify production identities to prepare tests.
testing.postgres_concurrency: npm run test:postgres requires PostgreSQL 17 on loopback and an empty, dedicated fdf_test_concurrency database via TEST_DATABASE_URL. CI provides an isolated service; no production or shared DEV connection is accepted.

contracts.name: analytics_events
rules: Never store raw emails, passwords, tokens, phone numbers or service keys in event properties.
Every event name must be allowlisted in src/lib/analytics/events.ts and app_prod.analytics_events.
If the event name, entity id, properties shape or Supabase schema changes, review analytics marts before completion.

contracts.name: analytics_reader
rules: Analytics reads from the analytics schema with a read-only role.
Do not use service role credentials in the analytics repo.

contracts.name: organization_groups_are_free
rules: Groups/organizations do not have a billing table, paid status, trial period or MercadoPago checkout.
Do not reintroduce organization_billing_payments or organization_billing_subscriptions for groups.
Clubs, leagues and tournaments are retired from this application. Historical analytics views may read private archives; do not restore product routes or billing.

impact_rules.description: Analytics event allowlist, client/server recorder or endpoint changed.
Login, registration or OAuth behavior can affect admin usage and retention marts.
Groups, players or matches changed; product activity marts may need updates.
Billing or payments changed; finance mart may need updates.
Super admin metrics changed; decide whether Streamlit should mirror or extend them.
Supabase Database type contract changed; analytics extraction schema may need updates.

product_scope.analytics_compatibility: Existing event names and historical read-only views preserved; new referral_visit event and optional event_key.
